summary: Your ninth Sunday review. You answer 8 questions on the context window, Docker and pgvector, upserts and indexes with a confidence number, extend your glossary, run the whole system from cold using only your README, group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 9 and plan week 10.
goal: Explain context rot, vectors in a database and indexes in your own words, start the system from cold, and plan week 10.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example from your assistant
Run it from cold: down, up, ingest and ask using only your README, and fix the README
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Run git tag week-9 and see tag: week-9 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 10: one outcome sentence, 7 sessions in your calendar, a drop list, and start the database
Play the Week 9 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
